pages.title: Shop
pages.content:
Food and things for every bowl: dog food, cat food, small pets and supplies. Orders in by 14:00 Monday to Friday are packed the same day, and a subscription takes 10% off every repeat delivery.

Free UK delivery over £40, otherwise £3.95.

pages.title: Food finder
pages.content: Three questions, one bowl: who are we feeding, how old are they, and is there anything to watch? Suggestions for dogs, cats and small pets follow.

pages.title: Subscribe & save
pages.content: 10% off every repeat delivery, every 2, 4, 6 or 8 weeks. Skip, change or cancel up to 48 hours before dispatch.

pages.title: About
pages.content: Mochi Pet Supply opened in 2017 on Brunton Lane in Leith, founded by Isla Morrow and Tomasz Kowal.

pages.title: Nutrition desk
pages.content: Thursdays 15:00–19:00: a free 20-minute chat with Dr Amara Osei, visiting veterinary nutritionist. General guidance only, not a diagnosis.

pages.title: Feeding guides
pages.content: Switch food over 10 days: days 1–3 25% new food, days 4–6 50%, days 7–9 75%, day 10 100%. Always check the pack and your vet.

pages.title: Delivery & returns
pages.content: Order by 14:00 Monday to Friday for same-day dispatch. UK delivery takes 1–2 working days; free over £40, otherwise £3.95. The van round is Tuesday and Friday, free in Leith, Portobello and Stockbridge. Unopened food, and unused beds and bowls, can come back within 30 days.

pages.title: Visit
pages.content: 18 Brunton Lane, Leith, Edinburgh EH6 6QT. Mon–Sat 9:00–19:00, Sun 10:00–16:00. hello@mochipets.example · +44 131 555 0174.

posts.title: Biscuit, 9, and the 10-day switch
posts.excerpt: A 9-year-old beagle moved to Senior Gentle Dog Food over 10 days.
posts.content: Biscuit is a 9-year-old beagle. Fiona Grant moved him to Senior Gentle Dog Food, turkey and pumpkin, over 10 days, and he is now on a 4-week subscription.

posts.title: Pepper & Salt on the van round
posts.excerpt: Two adopted cats and a box every 6 weeks.
posts.content: Pepper and Salt live with Mateo Ruiz. They mix Kitten & Senior Wet Food trays with Adult Cat Dry Food, white fish, and the box arrives every 6 weeks on the van round.

posts.title: Clover and the hay
posts.excerpt: A rabbit, a bundle of timothy hay every 4 weeks.
posts.content: Clover is a rabbit kept by Ngozi Achebe and her son Tobi. A 2.5 kg bundle of Timothy Hay, meadow cut, arrives every 4 weeks.
